messages:
maria_ops: FYI I'm seeing the EU flip in progress but traffic split is drifting — eu-west showing ~70% to green while eu-central is still ~20% to green. Customers are getting 502/504. Paging SRE.

deploy-bot: [deploy] bluegreen rollout started for service=frontier, version=stable->green @ 1761239950

alex_sre: on it, looking at metrics. can you paste the console rollout id?

maria_ops: rollout id: rb-20260315-0423

jamie_platform: I see DNS TTL still 300 in edge caches; our route propagation hasn't converged. Also noticed a geo-weight change pushed at 04:21 that didn't apply to the apac->eu mapping. suspect config drift.

alex_sre: ok hold — throttling traffic to green. setting feature flag to kill.

alex_sre: /infra/flags kill green-rollout-eu :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [action] feature-flag green-rollout-eu set to OFF by alex_sre

maria_ops: customer impact: AcmePayments reporting transaction timeouts in eu-west and eu-central. estimating ~12% of traffic affected based on top-line metrics.

sophia_support: notified AcmePayments support and sent initial status. they'll escalate if not resolved in 10m.

oncall_pager: taking lead for incident. switching to incident channel inc-1761239987

jamie_platform: recommend immediate rollback instead of just kill flag; kill helps but the rollout artifact still exists in DNS and edge caches causing sticky routes. rollback to v1.8.2 now.

alex_sre: executing rollback

alex_sre: ```bash
redwood rollout abort --id rb-20260315-0423 --mode immediate
```

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback command accepted. starting roll-forward->stable

eve_prodeng: when you abort, ensure kv-cache flush for frontier caches in eu to avoid prefix cache mismatch — otherwise old green responses can linger.

alex_sre: flushing KV caches now

alex_sre: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.edge.local/flush -d '{"service":"frontier","region":"eu"}'
```

deploy-bot: [task] kv-cache flush queued

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-0873 | Sev=2 | owner=oncall_pager | summary='split traffic drift during blue/green'

maria_ops: monitoring errors and latency; will post SLA impact estimate in 10m. cc @sophia_support

sophia_support: opened support case 45321 with AcmePayments, provided mitigation steps and ETA 15m

jamie_platform: confirm DNS TTL lowered to 60? currently still 300 in some edges. lowering TTL speeds convergence.

alex_sre: set edge-dns-ttl=60 via infra-console

deploy-bot: [config] edge-dns-ttl updated to 60

maria_ops: latency errors dropping in eu-west from ~18% -> ~6% after rollback. still seeing stragglers in eu-central, likely due to longer BGP/edge convergence.

eve_prodeng: propose a rolling regional re-weight: set eu-central weight->100% stable, handle eu-west manual cutover once metrics green.

alex_sre: applying weights

alex_sre: ```
redwood routing set-weights --service frontier --region eu-central --stable 1.0
```

deploy-bot: [routing] weights updated

oncall_pager: handing off to eve_prodeng for follow-up monitoring and RCA. if anything spikes re-pager @alex_sre

eve_prodeng: ack taking over. will coordinate postmortem and customer follow-up. creating RCA ticket and timeline.

sophia_support: sent follow-up to AcmePayments: rollback applied, partial impact resolved. support case id 45321, will update once fully cleared.

maria_ops: closing thread here, moving timeline to postmortem doc. thanks all :clap:
